verdict.rationale: The official firebase-tools CLI documents importing and exporting users from Firebase Auth, which is a first-party export path for one data type. Nothing in the evidence shows a complete export of Firestore, Realtime Database or Storage data in open formats. A community report also notes that security/storage rules must be reimplemented when switching providers. Missing for 10: documented full-database and storage export, specification of open export formats, a whole-project 'export all and leave' workflow, and independent corroboration of successful migrations off Firebase.
